Tuesday Night Ride (TNR)

Tucson, AZ · University of Arizona · Social

Tuesday Night Ride (TNR) is a social group ride in Tucson, AZ. It rolls every Tuesday at 8:45 pm from Flagpole in front of Old Main, University of Arizona. Pace: party pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @tuesdaynightbikeride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Ride (TNR) group ride

Tucson's big weekly party ride. Dozens of riders meet at the Old Main flagpole and roll through streets, alleys, parks and parking lots for about two hours. Bring lights and a helmet. Adults and experienced riders are the norm.
